snippet.title: Going Off Grid
snippet.description:
Welcome to our channel! We are just your standard Aussie couple but there is probably something seriously wrong with us!… after embarking on a journey of epic proportions! moving to the other side of the country, buying 13 acres and building a house off the grid, we have now decided to move BACK across the country and do the same thing all over again on 100 hectares in Tasmania!

Follow myself (Andrew), my wife Jenn and our two sausage dogs Vienna and Farley as we take on the process and have another good crack at Going Off Grid!

Oh yeah and there is also a splattering of Jeep related 4WD content posted every now and again! 

Thanks for stopping by.

😀 HAPPY WITH OUR VIDEOS? 😀

Don't forget to subscribe! - https://www.youtube.com/@GoingOffGridAus?sub_confirmation=1

snippet.title: EcoHabs for Earth
snippet.description:
Welcome to EcoHabs for Earth! We promote homesteading for a sustainable future, demonstrating regenerative living practices while conserving land within the Florida Wildlife Corridor to protect vital wildlife habitats. 
Our mission is to educate homeowners and businesses on:

•	Solar Energy & Renewable Power
•	Rainwater Harvesting
•	Regenerative Agriculture & Growing Food and Medicine
•	Off-Grid Ecological Habitats and Camps
•	Mindfulness Practices for harmonious living 

Join us to learn how to live freely off the grid, cultivate food/medicine forests, and be in harmony with Mother Earth. Together, we can ensure a thriving future for our children, grandchildren, and all life on our planet. 

We invite you to reach out to us, visit our website or support our mission via the links below!

snippet.title: Snowstead
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Snowstead — I’m David, I document the reality of building a resilient, simple, and self-sufficient life here in the forests of Ontario. From heating a tiny home through -30°C winters, to managing power with solar, generators, and clever backup systems, to DIY builds, tools, bushcraft, and seasonal challenges — everything you see here is hands-on, tested, and learned the hard way.

If you’re into:
• Homesteading & tiny home living
• Off-grid power, heating, and backup systems
• DIY builds, tools, and practical problem solving
• Wilderness, forest living & outdoor life
• Real stories instead of flashy ads

…then this is your place.

I share what works, what fails, and everything I wish I knew sooner — with videos packed with first-hand experience, honest reviews, and practical takeaways you can use at home.

Stick around for weekly stories, seasonal projects, and grounded, down-to-earth content from the forest.
Welcome to the Snowstead!

snippet.title: Peter Santenello
snippet.description:
I make videos showing you a world that the media fails to capture. 

No BS polarization or political angle—just pure authentic interactions with the locals. 

I present the story. You present your own opinion.

We'll learn about the people of Appalachia, the Chicanos, and the Native Americans. I dive into the full range of America, from the Amish to the Bloods and Crips. 

The goal is to get into someone else’s world to understand them and ourselves better. 

The ingredients are: a GoPro, simple editing, curiosity, a search for truth, and most importantly, authentic human interactions.

I’ve lived abroad in four countries and traveled to 85 countries. I've taken this perspective back to the USA to show Americans and the world what this great nation is like away from the mainstream media.

snippet.description:
Welcome to The 7 Kin Homestead YT Channel, where we empower individuals and families to win at the off-grid living and homesteading game, on a budget. Join our community of like-minded parents and adventure-seekers as we embark on an exciting journey towards freedom, self-sufficiency, and pure happiness. Get ready for a dose of practical tips, inspiring stories, and entertaining content that will revolutionize your way of life.

We're here to challenge the status quo, laugh in the face of limitations, and celebrate the rebel in you. Together, we'll shatter the constraints that hold you back. 

But it's not all serious business—we love a good laugh! Our videos are a breath of fresh air, a delightful escape from the pressures of everyday life. We celebrate risk-takers who dare to chase their dreams, whether they succeed or fail.

Let's learn, grow, and have a blast together as we explore the path to a more self-reliant, joy-filled existence. Welcome to the 7 Kin Homestead family!

snippet.title: Shawn James - My Self Reliance
snippet.description:
Shawn James is an outdoorsman, log cabin builder, and self-reliance educator documenting life off the grid in the wilderness. After building a hand-hewn log cabin from scratch with no power tools, Shawn and his wife are now exploring North America in search of land, freedom, and a life that demands real skills.

On this channel: off-grid living, wilderness homesteading, log cabin building, bushcraft, hunting, fishing, foraging, and the honest cost of choosing self-reliance over convenience. As a 56-year-old father of two, Shawn isn't retiring — he's going further.

My Self Reliance channel: https://www.youtube.com/@MySelfReliance

snippet.title: Cabin River Outdoors
snippet.description:
In 2021, (after years of searching) I was able to purchase a 41 acre/16.5 hectare property deep in the mountains of western Canada at a bargain price.  It felt like winning a lottery!  One of the only private properties in this gigantic region. 
 Far away from just about any form of civilization and surrounded by an endless wilderness of valleys, rivers, lakes and large trees, I knew I had found a rare gem of private land.  
With no roads, no neighbors and very little building restrictions (and not to mention a river and creek that runs through it all !), I couldn't be happier with this freedom in the wilderness. 
 Follow my journey while I try and carve something out of this raw and sometimes unforgiving wilderness.   
Starting from the ground up, I have my work cut out for me.   - Shawn

snippet.title: Simple Living Alaska
snippet.description:
In 2018 we made the 2,500 mile trek from Oregon to Alaska. We downsized our house, our land, and our possessions in pursuit of a self sufficient dream. We landed at a tiny cabin surrounded by forest in beautiful Southcentral AK, never expecting we would be living "off the grid." Each day we face new challenges as we learn to embrace our life here in the wilderness of Alaska.

Tag along to share our experience living life to the fullest, connecting with nature and creating food we are passionate about. 

Cheers,
The Illia Family

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SimpleLivingAlaska/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/simplelivingalaska/

Me, My husband & our son have a dream of living off grid. In 2024, We finally decided to make that dream a reality. After months of research our hearts settled in Cochise County Arizona. We purchased 5.5 acres of raw land and decided to turn that piece of land into our DREAM. Soon, we will be leaving  behind our home, family and everything we know, to pursue our dreams. snippet.title: My Wild Holm
snippet.description:
Life on an Off-Grid Wilderness Island

Welcome to My Wild Holm. We’re Ryan and Melodi, and in 2022 we bought a 62-acre island on a remote lake in the Canadian wilderness.

Since then, we’ve been building an off-grid homestead from the ground up, one project, one mistake, and one hard-earned lesson at a time.

We’re not trying to disappear from the modern world completely. We’re focused on building a life that brings together wilderness freedom, practical self-reliance, solar power, internet access with as many of the modern comforts that will make this place livable for the long haul.

Follow along as we turn a raw wilderness island into an off-grid home, with all the work, weather, wildlife, setbacks, systems and everyday learning that comes along with it.

Off-grid cabin builds

snippet.title: Can't Contain Us
snippet.description:
NEW VIDEOS EVERY WEEK
Cody and I met in Texas, fell in love, and took a leap of faith. We sold our house, let go of almost everything, and chased a dream. That dream brought us to 20 acres of raw land where we’re building a shipping container tiny home from the ground up. It hasn’t been easy, but every challenge—from weather setbacks to learning as we go—has made us more determined. Our goal is to live simply, self-sufficiently, and fully off-grid. With our three dogs, eight chickens, and two ducks by our side, we’re sharing our journey of creating a cozy, intentional lifestyle through DIY projects, homesteading, and plenty of trial and error. If you love the outdoors, sustainable living, or chasing big dreams, you’re in the right place. Follow along and see what we can accomplish together.

Instagram: @cantcontainus
Facebook: @cantcontainus
TikTok: @cantcontainus

It hasn’t been easy, but every challenge—from weather setbacks to learning as we go—has made us more determined. Our goal is to live simply, self-sufficiently, and fully off-grid. With our three dogs, eight chickens, and two ducks by our side, we’re sharing our journey of creating a cozy, intentional lifestyle through DIY projects, homesteading, and plenty of trial and error. If you love the outdoors, sustainable living, or chasing big dreams, you’re in the right place. Follow along and see what we can accomplish together.

snippet.title: Martin Johnson - Off Grid Living
snippet.description:
Maybe you're like us and want a peaceful life of freedom and independence in the country. 

When we lived in the city that is exactly what we dreamed of. In the city were dependent on someone else to provide us with everything we needed, like electricity, water, and food. We knew that if any one of those systems failed we would be stuck and need someone to rescue us. 

So, we packed up our family and moved to a 7-acre piece of raw land in North Idaho. 

We’re just regular middle-class folks with very little practical experience in building, gardening, or raising animals. But, we were willing to give it a shot and couldn’t be happier with our decision.

If inexperienced people like us can become debt-free and find a peaceful life of freedom and independence in the country, so can you. We’ll show you how by sharing the skills and tips needed to make the move through our inspirational videos. 

For business/sponsorship inquires: martinjohnsonoffgridliving@wildamerica.management

snippet.title: Fowler's Makery and Mischief
snippet.description:
Bushcrafter, Outdoorsman, and Youtube Creator Zachary Fowler is a Vermont native who moved to coastal Maine to become a wooden boat builder. Although building classic wooden boats was a passion and skill, Zach's real love was always for the outdoors. This would be expressed by his years providing for his family, occupying an off-grid Yurt-style home, and living a self-sufficient lifestyle. 

Fowler's enthusiasm for the outdoors and strong work ethic was proven when he applied for and won History channel's “Alone” show, where he survived for 87 days in Patagonia, "catch and cooking" 63 fish and 2 birds. After surviving and winning the show Fowler chose to start his own Youtube channel where he could reach an audience and share his appreciation and knowledge of the great outdoors through video series such as the “30 Day Survival Challenge” and “Trick-Shot-Tuesday”. On this channel, you will find a plethora of catch and cooks, primitive and modern survival, and tons of fun!
